description:
Who subcontracts to whom on U.S. federal contracts, from FSRS / USAspending subaward reports: subaward number, prime award number, prime and subawardee (name, UEI), amount, date, NAICS, agency and description, newest first, plus a count and total over every match. Give 'prime' and/or 'subawardee' as a company name (matches names that start with it, e.g. 'LOCKHEED MARTIN') or a 12-character SAM UEI. Use it to find a prime's subcontractors or a firm's prime partners.
FREE tier: 20 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

prime.description: Prime contractor name prefix or UEI.
